Method of Attack: Exploitation of the PidLidReminderFileParameter extended MAPI property to leak NTLMv2 hashes via a crafted email
Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attack to intercept and poison NTLM authentication requests
Attack Vector: Crafted email with a malicious UNC path in the PidLidReminderFileParameter property
Automatic reminder pop-up triggering NTLM authentication
Indicators of Compromise: PidLidReminderFileParameter message property pointing to a malicious UNC path
